labels.elapsedPeriod: Time in this step at least
labels.allowEntityChange: Re-evaluate when the person/record is edited

conditionTypes.anySignal: Any of these events just arrived

conditionOperators.greaterThanOrEquals: is greater than or equal to
conditionOperators.lessThanOrEquals: is less than or equal to

messages.conditionsBuilderHint: Choose what must happen before advancing. Use Event received now to filter one incoming event's data. Use Event in history to combine actions that may happen at different times.
messages.conditionsEmpty: No conditions yet. Add the first event, field, or elapsed time.
messages.entityFilterHint: Pick a standard field or a Custom Field. Only records in this journey’s workspace are checked.
messages.entityFilterEmpty: Add at least one field rule.
messages.payloadPathNeedEvent: Choose which event will be received first.
messages.payloadPathEmptyCatalog: This event has no known fields available for filtering.
messages.elapsedInStageHint: Counts from when the record entered this step. Examples: 3 days, 12 hours.
messages.currentSignalHint: Evaluates only the current arrival. Filters below use data from this same event.
messages.anySignalHint: Advances when any selected event arrives.
messages.eventDataFiltersEmpty: No filters: every occurrence of this event is accepted.
messages.incomingEventGroupHint: The event and its filters are evaluated together. To require events that happen at different times, add Event in history conditions.
messages.multipleIncomingAndWarning: Two different events cannot arrive at the same time. To require several events in any order, replace these with Event in history conditions.
messages.ungroupedPayloadWarning: Legacy condition without an event source. Inside an OR group, it may accept data from any incoming event. Remove it and add Event received now to bind it to the correct event.
messages.advancedNestedGroupHint: This group was created in advanced JSON. Edit it under Advanced (JSON).

tooltips.scope: Choose a specific source step, any active step in this journey, or a rule for new enrollments.
tooltips.fromStage: Required only when Applies to is One specific step.
tooltips.toStage: Where the record goes next when this connection fires.
tooltips.waitPeriod: Set automatically from “time in step” rules.
tooltips.eventCodes: Set automatically from the event rules.
tooltips.wakeSources: Set automatically from the rules above.
tooltips.priority: If several connections could fire, higher priority wins first.
tooltips.conditionsGroup: When should the record move to the next step?
tooltips.conditionsFormula: Advanced true/false formula. When set, it replaces the rules builder.
tooltips.triggerType: Set automatically from the rules above.
